bugs.signature: unsafe impl<T: Send> Send for ReadTicket<T>
bugs.rationale: RUSTSEC-2020-0119: ticketed_lock's ReadTicket / WriteTicket carry hand-written `unsafe impl Send` bounds that do not enforce the exclusive-access invariant the abstraction documents. The crate exposes a 'ticketed lock' interface but the Send/Sync surface lets the guard escape to a thread that did not acquire the ticket -- the documented `RwLock`-like exclusion never lands. Unmaintained; no upstream fix.
